title.zh: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending
title.en: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending

current_state.zh: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
current_state.en: ESMA proposed MiCA rules that would require licensing for DeFi gateways, staking, and lending services and bar crypto firms from offering MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins.
